purpose: Public-source national security and intelligence reference layer. It models institutions, parent states, broad mandates and public oversight without asserting secret operations.

records.name: Politiets Efterretningstjeneste (PET)
records.mandate: Domestic security, counterterrorism, counterintelligence and protection of the constitutional order.

records.name: Forsvarets Efterretningstjeneste (FE)
records.mandate: Foreign and military intelligence in support of Danish national security and defence.

records.name: Politiets sikkerhetstjeneste (PST)
records.mandate: Domestic security, counterintelligence, counterterrorism and protective security.

records.name: National Security Authority (NSM)
records.mandate: Preventive security, cyber and information-security functions.

records.name: Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (MUST)
records.mandate: Military intelligence and security for the Swedish Armed Forces.

records.name: Säkerhetspolisen (Säpo)
records.mandate: Counterintelligence, counterterrorism, security protection and constitutional security.

records.name: Suojelupoliisi (Supo)
records.mandate: National security intelligence, counterintelligence and counterterrorism.

records.name: Central Intelligence Agency
records.mandate: Foreign intelligence and national-security analysis; covert action under lawful presidential authority.

records.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
records.mandate: Federal criminal investigation, counterterrorism, counterintelligence, cyber and civil-rights enforcement.

records.name: National Security Agency
records.mandate: Signals intelligence and cybersecurity in support of national security.

records.name: Defense Intelligence Agency
records.mandate: Military and defence intelligence.

records.name: Mossad
records.mandate: Strategic intelligence and special operations in support of Israeli national security.

records.name: Israel Security Agency (Shin Bet/Shabak)
records.mandate: Internal security, counterterrorism and counterintelligence.

records.name: Security Service (MI5)

records.name: Secret Intelligence Service (SIS/MI6)
records.mandate: Foreign intelligence collection for national security and foreign policy.

records.name: Government Communications Headquarters
records.mandate: Signals intelligence and cyber security.

records.name: Direction générale de la sécurité extérieure (DGSE)
records.mandate: External intelligence and national-security missions.

records.name: Direction générale de la sécurité intérieure (DGSI)
records.mandate: Internal security, counterterrorism and counterintelligence.

records.name: Bundesnachrichtendienst (BND)
records.mandate: Foreign intelligence for the German federal government.

records.name: Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz (BfV)
records.mandate: Protection of the constitutional order, counterextremism and counterespionage.

records.name: Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD)
records.mandate: National security intelligence, counterterrorism, counterespionage and security screening.

records.name: Militaire Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (MIVD)
records.mandate: Military intelligence and security.

records.name: VSSE
records.mandate: Civil intelligence and security protection.

records.name: ADIV/SGRS
records.mandate: Military intelligence and security.

records.name: Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS)
records.mandate: Security intelligence concerning threats to Canadian security.

records.name: Communications Security Establishment (CSE)
records.mandate: Foreign signals intelligence and cybersecurity services.

records.name: Australian Security Intelligence Organisation (ASIO)
records.mandate: Domestic security intelligence.

records.name: Australian Signals Directorate (ASD)
records.mandate: Signals intelligence and cyber security.

records.name: Joint Intelligence Committee
records.mandate: All-source intelligence assessment and strategic warning.

records.name: Europol
records.mandate: Information exchange and operational analytical support against serious crime and terrorism.

records.name: INTERPOL
records.mandate: International police cooperation and criminal information exchange.

guardrails: Do not infer covert operations from geography or liaison membership.
Do not fabricate personnel counts for clandestine agencies.
Separate legal mandate, public reporting, historical allegation and verified operational fact.
